question: Savitribai, together with her husband Jyotirao Phule, founded one of India's first girls' schools in Pune, at Bhide Wada in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1848.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Savitribai** and her husband **Jyotirao Phule** were **social reformers** who worked towards the **upliftment of women** and** lower-caste **communities in India.
 
• They founded one of India's first girls' schools in **Pune, Maharashtra, **which was established in **1848 at Bhide Wada**.
 
• The school aimed to provide **education to girls** who were otherwise denied access to learning opportunities due to** social and cultural **barriers.
 
• The school **faced opposition** from conservative elements in society, who believed that educating girls was against traditional values and norms.
 
• However, Savitribai and Jyotirao **persisted **in their efforts and continued to expand the school's reach.
 
• Over time, their work inspired the establishment of other **schools and educational institutions** for girls across India, and they are now widely recognized as pioneers of women's education in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Savitribai Phule was the **first female teacher in India** and played a significant role in promoting **women's education **in the country.
 
• She was also a** poet** and wrote several **poems on social issues** such as caste discrimination, women's rights, and education.
 
• Savitribai and Jyotirao Phule also established the **Satyashodhak Samaj,** a social reform organization that worked towards the emancipation of **lower-caste communities** in India.
 
• The couple faced **opposition and criticism **from conservative elements in society for their progressive views and actions, but they continued to work towards their goals with determination and courage.
